This question is off-topic.

The Chromium project supports Web Bluetooth. Any browser based on it will support the API. How to build your own Chromium-based browser is off-topic for this forum.

Yes, but the entire Chromium project is too big, I just want to make a webview compatible with your webble api, I refer to the ios webble project, this is feasible, but I don’t know how to bridge it

Hope you can recommend some projects or methods to tell me, thank you

Web Bluetooth is unfortunately not supported in Android WebView. This is tracked as: https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=1100993

There is no project I am aware of which adds Web Bluetooth to Android WebView in the same way that WebBLE adds it to WKWebView.

Why do you need to package your own browser on Android? The Web Bluetooth API is supported in Chrome, Edge and other Chromium-based browsers on Android.

I am sorry but I still don't understand the problem you are trying to solve. Why can't your application be run in one of the many browsers on Android that support Web Bluetooth? Why are you trying to package your own web browser?

> I am sorry but I still don't understand the problem you are trying to solve. Why can't your application be run in one of the many browsers on Android that support Web Bluetooth? Why are you trying to package your own web browser?

Thank you for the explanation. At this point the path forward for this without building your own Chromium-based browser is to wait for Android WebView to support the Web Bluetooth API, which is tracked by the issue linked above. Thank you for this information on developer needs.
